thought.title: Fused-input softmax with DataCopyPad for CANN 8.5.0
thought.description: Pre-fuse qk+bias and mask on Python side into single input with -inf for masked positions. Single VECIN/VECOUT AscendC kernel computes softmax via fp32 TBuf: Cast fp16→fp32, scalar max-find, Adds(-max), Exp, scalar sum, Muls(1/sum), Cast fp32→fp16. Uses DataCopyPad for GM↔UB transfers (plain DataCopy fails in CANN 8.5.0). Mask convention: mask==0→-inf (exp(-inf)=0).
thought.reason: Multi-VECIN-queue fails CANN 8.5.0 TQue depth assertion. Pre-fusion enables single-queue design. DataCopyPad is required for correct GM↔UB transfer in this CANN version. RMS-norm kernel pattern (1 VECIN, 1 VECOUT, TBuf) proven reliable.
thought.target_bottleneck: Scalar loops on TBuf limit throughput; single-row processing with no vectorization

runtime.dsl_before: No working kernel - all attempts crashed with 507057 or produced zeros
runtime.dsl_after: 1 VECIN queue (depth=1) + 1 VECOUT queue + 1 TBuf fp32. DataCopyPad for GM↔UB. Softmax: Cast→Adds(max)→Exp→Muls(1/sum)→Cast.
